rewards_accrual_enabled.meaning: the target GTELaunchpadV2Pair has rewards accrual enabled

accrued_launchpad_fee0_positive.meaning: the pair has accrued some launchpad fee0 (accruedLaunchpadFee0 > 0)

accrued_launchpad_fee1_positive.meaning: the pair has accrued some launchpad fee1 (accruedLaunchpadFee1 > 0)

no_token_transfers_in_call.meaning: no token transfers into the pair occur in the call

caller_has_no_special_permissions.meaning: the caller is any external user without special permissions, needing only gas to call mint(), swap(), or burn()

pair_is_graduated_launch_quote_pool.meaning: the pair is a launch-quote asset pool for a graduated launch token, i.e. one of the pairs the impact says are affected

affected_pair_scope_holds.meaning: the reported impact scope holds: all pairs for the launchpad's launch-quote asset pools for all graduated launch tokens are affected

assumptions: The report describes a conditional scenario; no concrete transaction is supplied, so the checked action is any of mint(), swap(), or burn() called on the pair.
Whether mint(), swap(), and burn() are alternative or sequential steps is unspecified; the plan treats each as an alternative call path.
Accrued fee amounts are not quantified; the plan only records that some fees are accrued.
The impact statement is a scope claim about which pairs are affected, not a quantified per-pair value.

unresolved.description: The selected impact imp_affects_all_graduated_pairs is a scope/universality claim ('all pairs for the launchpad's launch-quote asset pools for all graduated launch tokens') rather than a concrete observable state/value relation; the report gives no per-pair observable that distinguishes affected from unaffected pairs, so the relation is encoded only as a grounded scope Boolean.
The report does not define a concrete observable that would witness the scope claim for a specific pair (e.g. a per-pair flag or registry entry); later code binding must supply it.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the scope impact imp_affects_all_graduated_pairs; the asset-theft, repeated-drain, and liquidity-pool-loss impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
The scope relation is represented by grounded Booleans because the report states the affected set qualitatively without a numeric or per-pair observable.
The checked action is not fixed to one function; mint(), swap(), and burn() are treated as alternative call paths per the report's ambiguity note.
No concrete amounts, addresses, or transaction data are supplied; all quantities remain symbolic.
